## Lancaster University

### Senior Teaching Associate, July 2026 to present

I teach statistics and research methods at undergraduate and postgraduate level. I lecture on the MSc in Psychology and Behavioural Analytics, and deliver workshops in social psychology. I am a Year 2 Tutor and a Year 3 Academic Tutor, supervise undergraduate dissertations, act as External Moderator for statistics teaching at Sunway University, and provide R & stats support.

### Teaching Associate, January to May 2024

Designed and delivered lectures and labs for undergraduate qualitative methods, and managed teaching assistants during teaching and marking.

### Teaching Assistant, October 2019 to October 2023

Delivered undergraduate teaching across Psychology modules, including Cognitive Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Neuropsychology, Personality and Individual Differences, Research Methods, Statistics, R Programming, and Open Science Practices. Led RStudio support sessions for student projects. Over 700 hours of teaching in total.

### Supervision

Supervision of undergraduate and postgraduate dissertation projects.

### Guest lectures

- "Climate Futures Between Collapse and Transformation: Scientists' Discourse and the Politics of Possibility". SGA420 *Navigating Sustainability and Global Environmental Futures*, 2025.
- "The Psychology of Scientist Activism". PSYCH601, MSc Social Psychology.
